sloka: तयोस्ते धनुषी श्रेष्ठे बाहुभिः परिघोपमैः।विकृष्यमाणे बलवत् क्रौञ्चाविव चुकूजतुः ।। ६.९१.४९ ।।
transliteration: tayoste dhanuṣī śreṣṭhe bāhubhiḥ parighopamaiḥ।vikṛṣyamāṇe balavat krauñcāviva cukūjatuḥ ।। 6.91.49 ।।

translations.english: That arrow was gifted to Lakshmana in dream by Kubera, the god of wealth and even Suras or Asuras cannot resist it and is difficult to win.
